history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#731; borg-reborn-rs #1066, #1094, PR #1096, merged into track-p as 6cd5c8bf; tracked there as #1073). Four arms at track-p 6cd5c8bf, every arm writing both switches so each means the same on any specimen: shipped (escape_phase_unknown_scary 1, escape_phase_newcomer_wait 1, the specimen as shipped); phase0 (0, 0, the play before #1066); unknown (1, 0); newcomer (0, 1). Comparisons are paired by start against phase0 (exact McNemar). Pilot as the gate, then the full tier (classes-1800 starts 901-1800, 900 per arm, which holds both case starts, Half-Troll Priest 694417276 and Half-Elf Blackguard 2025089708). Second step only if the first points that way (not defined here): unknown-soft-hp (escape_phase_unknown_hp_percent 30), unknown-soft-tol (escape_phase_unknown_tolerance 90), newcomer-strict (escape_phase_newcomer_turn_percent 50), newcomer-brave (escape_phase_newcomer_hp_percent 30), each with both switches at 1.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen track-p 6cd5c8bf. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report: deaths per arm paired by start against phase0 (rescued and newly killed, exact McNemar), per class, with CL and DL at death and the deaths on DL1-2; the progress cost (max DL and CL, turns to DL3 and DL5, first_turn_at_depth, #718's level fields); per game from the notes (pilot evidence) the #1066 markers ('never seen (#1066)' refusals, 'never-seen landing grids' gate refusals, 'the Phase Door waits for the newcomer'); a death report with screens (/death-report) for the deaths in shipped that phase0 survives and the reverse. Descriptive at the pilot (RULES 14); a claim needs the full tier and a confirmation on an unopened block.
